comparison_note: The source side is the CSV finance_excel_report.pl itself wrote over the pinned fixtures, parsed into ow_tp.bronze.custbill_legacy_baseline_close by a loader that imports none of the converted code. The target side recomputes the close from ow_tp.silver.custbill and never reads that table. Compared per group: sort_key, row_order, currency, the displayed record_type, record_count and total_amount. row_order is compared as well as the key set, so an ordering regression fails the gate rather than passing as a set match; money is exact per the frozen tolerances.

planted_anomaly_detections.compared_as: set of (report group, row count) over the malformed groups in ow_tp.gold.custbill_finance_close, per the frozen tolerances; expected_set read from the captured legacy CSV, actual_set read from the gold table
planted_anomaly_detections.derivation: The first two groups are the two halves of the one delimiter-collision record: the extra '|' in the customer name shifts the amount into the currency position and the currency into the record-type position. The rest are the probe fixture's unknown record type, its lower-case currency with a single-space type, and its empty-currency record. Counts are report rows, and each of these groups holds exactly one record.

legacy_defects_reproduced: The delimiter collision keeps its nonsense group: the record with a '|' in the customer name shifts every later field, so the report still shows 0US,UNKNOWN(D0) and 000000020000,UNKNOWN(USD). The aggregation re-splits the rendered psv_line positionally rather than reading silver's clean columns, because grouping the clean columns would repair the defect and change the totals (C-5.1, P2-D03).
Amounts are coerced the way the Perl coerced them: a leading numeric prefix, junk contributing 0.00 while the row still counts toward record_count.
usd and USD are separate groups; the grouping is case-sensitive because the Perl's hash key is.
Record types other than 01 and 02 keep their raw bytes in UNKNOWN(<raw>), including the empty and single-space types.
The only row skipped is the one whose first positional field is empty, matching the Perl.
unverified_paths: P2-D01, the landing race: the legacy chain can produce a close from a half-written .dat; the target lands atomically and sequences every stage as a dependency edge. Named behaviour change, not exercisable against pinned inputs.

The sendmail step is dropped, not reproduced. The mail pipe has been dead for years, so there is nothing to reconcile against; the gold table and the volume export are the replacement surfaces and the job's failure notification replaces the mail in wave 4 (D-007 / D4-01, confirmed at STOP E).
Structure parity: the harness compares rows, not Delta table properties, comments or grants, and nothing checks the grants on the export volume path.

The export file name: the legacy took its date from the ETL box's local clock, the job takes an explicit stamp. Byte identity is proven for the file contents, not for the name the scheduler will choose.
Inputs outside the pinned fixture set - other currencies, other record types, other delimiter placements - are not exercised.
closed_at is target-side wall clock with no legacy counterpart and is excluded from both the keyed diff and the idempotency fingerprint.
